title: Derived closed costalk continuity on strict bounded diagrams
statement: Let T be a scheme with noetherian underlying space, Λ a commutative condensed ring, and i:Z→T a closed immersion. Let H be any additive right adjoint of internal module pushforward i_*. For a (u+1)-small filtered diagram D of internal Λ_T-module cochain complexes, a common strict lower bound a, and q∈ℤ, the canonical comparison from colim_s H^q(RH(QD_s)) to H^q(RH(Q(colim_s truncGE_a D_s))) is an isomorphism. Its legs are RH applied to the original complexes' good-truncation projections followed by their colimit inclusions. Here the internal module categories are [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category], and Q and RH belong to [def-weil-abstract-derived-category].

proof.text: For any filtered cocone of distinguished triangles, form the five-term portions of its long exact cohomology sequences. Exact filtered colimits give exact top rows; the ordinary five lemma shows that continuity for the middle and third vertices implies continuity for the first. This is the proved triangleComparison_isIso helper.

proof.text: The good-truncated cocone of D is colimiting because every truncation projection is invertible under the strict lower bound. Cohomology preserves filtered colimits. Restriction k* is exact and preserves colimits; qcqs pushforward continuity, transferred between the two colimit cocones, proves the third-vertex comparison.

theorem condensed_closed_costalk_derived_continuity
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace T]
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    {Z : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ T) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (H : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ T) ⥤
      Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Z) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ Z))
    [H.Additive] (adj : CondensedRing.lowerStar Λ i ⊣ H)
    {I : Type (u + 1)} [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I]
    (D : I ⥤ CochainComplex
      (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ T)) ℤ)
    (a : ℤ) (hD : ∀ s, (D.obj s).IsStrictlyGE a) (q : ℤ) :
    IsIso (condensedContinuityComparison D a
      (DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ H.rightDerivedFunctor ⋙ DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q))
